name: OpenAPI nested schema and examples
accept: Click field names and padding, expand/collapse all, touch a nested field, Tab/Enter, switch example language and response status. Targets >=44 CSS px; both locales offer the same controls.

name: Tables, callouts and code tabs
accept: Read DELETE and 100/second; read long descriptions and nested callouts. Scroll to the final column locally. Switch all three installation tab groups with click and arrow keys; rounded frames remain intact.

name: Authored MDX and platform navigation
accept: Open the mobile TOC, jump to a real member, use Back, and read its parameters and code. Heading remains visible below the sticky navigation.

name: TypeDoc overloads and notices
accept: Match each of the three overloads to its own signature, parameters and return value. Compatibility and HTTPS notices retain their structure and meaning. Long Promise/tuple return types wrap in their cell, retain every type link, and leave the description readable at compact widths. Optional/Readonly are signature metadata, not part of the member heading; property declarations use the native signature frame. Nested object fields are ordinary lists in their parent cell, without independent cards. Explicit notices use standard callouts without quotation marks or italic text; actual quotations remain quotes.

name: Oxygen parameter lists
accept: Both historical fragments navigate correctly; description bullets, numbering and nesting are visible and distinct from possible-value badges.

name: Doxygen Android Whiteboard
accept: Table headers name parameters rather than source paths. Read member details and navigate a real type link. Summary tables have no decorative blank rows or visible anchor URLs. Inherited destinations still work, spans remain native table cells, and introductory prose stays unchanged.

name: Appledoc Objective-C names and tables
accept: Keep valid Objective-C -/+ markers and Declared In metadata. A plain .h label need not be a link. Real type links work; four-column descriptions stay readable via local scrolling.

name: DITA structures
accept: Structure members, signatures and descriptions remain associated. Long identifiers wrap or scroll without widening the entire page.

name: Legacy authored REST reference
accept: Read long request and response sections, follow TOC links and horizontally scroll long code within its frame.

name: API entries and legacy navigation
accept: Navigate from the API entry through a product and version. External SDK current-version links and historical entry links have correct destinations; external templates are outside this repo's fix scope. From a C++ enum, click the RTC product breadcrumb to its filtered catalog and the platform ancestor to its real overview; use Back to return.

name: English Whiteboard local links
accept: Follow conversion and deprecated-reference links. Both resolve to the intended language and page; cross-page anchors remain valid.

name: Shared styles across languages
accept: Compare the same endpoint in both locales in light/dark and a narrow viewport. Behavior and spacing agree; only translated text and intentional product differences vary.

name: Authored language and syntax highlighting
accept: Programming-language fences show real syntax tokens in both themes; known API prototypes carry their SDK language. Plain output stays plain. Language captions, code values and copy behavior agree with the authored source.

name: Native parameter tables and linked signature frames
accept: Parameter and return lists use the ordinary native DocsTable scroll surface. Signature frames match ordinary Fumadocs code frames. Type links and modifiers remain on the same native code line in the same monospace font; copy excludes metadata labels, and type links plus historical parameter anchors still resolve. Imported linked-signature content is absent from English; verify its shared module with bilingual component fixtures.
